articles.title: 2027: Atiku lied, Tinubu not planning to postpone elections - Presidential aide

President Bola Tinubu's Special Assistant on Social Media, Dada Olusegun, has said there is no plan to postpone the 2027 general elections, contrary to the "lies" of the African Democratic Congress, ADC, presidential candidate, Atiku Abubakar. Olusegun said Tinubu and the All Progressives Congress, APC, have nothing to do with any such plan, if there […]
2027: Atiku lied, Tinubu no
articles.hausa_translation: 2027: Atiku ya yi karya, Tinubu ba ya shirya juyawa zaben - Mataimaki Shugaban Kasa. Mataimaki Tinubu akan jiya a kan media, Dada Olusegun, ya ce babu wani shiri na juyawa zaben 2027, akasin ƙarya na ADC dan takarar shugaban kasa Atiku Abubakar.
critical_questions: Why is the government's social media aide the one making this denial rather than an official electoral commission or press statement, and does this choice of messenger suggest concern about credibility?

Is there a pattern of similar postponement rumors in previous election cycles in Nigeria, and what typically motivates such claims?
Who benefits politically from this accusation and counter-accusation at this particular moment in the political calendar?

articles.title: Expert urges Tinubu to explore Sukuk over fresh foreign loans
articles.summary: A financial expert, Asiwaju Busari Shaamsuddeen Akande, has urged the Federal Government to explore sovereign Sukuk and other non-interest financing instruments as part of efforts to fund infrastructure without worsening Nigeria’s debt burden. Akande, who made the recommendation in Calabar while examining President Bola Tinubu’s proposed external borrowing plan, said the government should combine
articles.hausa_translation: Jagora ya bukaci Tinubu ya bincika Sukuk maimakon sabon baje-jari na waje. Ƙwararrun jari, Asiwaju Busari Shaamsuddeen Akande, ya bukaci gwamnatin tarayya ta tafi gida kan sukuk da sauran kayan tarayya mara-riba domin a yi gida da abubuwan haɗi gida ba tare da ƙarin baje-jari ba. Akande ya bayar da shawarwarinsa a Calabar yayin da yake duban shirin ƙarin baje-jari na waje na Shugaban Bola Tinubu.
critical_questions: Who is Asiwaju Busari Shaamsuddeen Akande and what are his financial ties or interests in Sukuk instruments?
